scope.name: Session Closeout and Campaign Continuity
scope.responsibility: Turn session end into durable zero-secretary campaign memory by reconciling attendance, rewards, loot, advancement, world-state changes, recap, missed-session catch-up, timelines, rulings, and real-world versus in-world time without requiring duplicate journal maintenance.
exit_criteria: Session finalization captures all material state changes and unresolved threads.
Previously-on and missed-session catch-up respect character/player information boundaries.
Material approved play/state changes project into continuity without duplicate manual entry where technically possible.
AI-assisted recap or organization remains advisory/attributable and cannot silently invent canon.
The next session begins from reconciled continuity rather than human memory or a manually maintained second database.
